claims.originating_goal: Add one admitted live-weather data-source capability to the existing primary Ecosystem Chat so current/future weather questions can return real forecast data without creating a second conversational runtime or granting provider/model authority.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release after exact-head validation, merge, deployment, and a public iPhone weather query returns a real forecast from the admitted data path with fail-closed fallback preserved.
collision_boundaries: Use the existing primary Ecosystem Chat surface only.
Do not create another LLM/provider runtime lane.
Weather source is evidence/data only; execution/model authority remains NONE.
Require explicit browser geolocation permission before device location is used.
Preserve semantic fail-closed fallback when forecast data cannot be obtained.
claims.next_task_after_release: Generalize the admitted dynamic-data contract to other time-sensitive factual capabilities only after weather is observed live and governed evidence semantics are proven.
